name: Read-Once Boolean Substitution Bound
statement: Let a Boolean formula use binary AND and OR, possibly negated literals, with every leaf coordinate occurring exactly once. If the input has a maximum parent of rank $r$ with $m$ auxiliaries and the formula has $g$ binary gates, the substituted class has a maximum parent of rank $r+g$ with at most $m+g$ auxiliaries.
proof: Coordinate reflections implement literal negations and turn disjunction into conjunction by De Morgan duality. Expand the read-once tree from its root and apply the one-gate conjunction construction at each binary gate. Disjoint subtrees ensure that no coordinate identification is needed, and each step adds one to both rank and the auxiliary upper bound.
